title: Self-Evolving Skills via Surrogate-Guided Solve-and-Reproduce
abstract: arXiv:2608.28638v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent skills are portable packages of instructions and resources an agent consults at deployment. Self-evolving them fails in two ways today. First, skills evolved from scratch underperform human-curated ones and, on a weak model, using no skill at all. Second, an evolution-time pass records one lucky trajectory that a fresh stochastic agent often fails to reproduce at deployment. We present reSolve, a per-task, oracle-in-the-loop framework built on three components. It decouples interactive solving from a self-contained deliverable that is independently re-executed in a fresh container, a protocol we call solve-and-reproduce. It enhances the sparse reward signal with a surrogate verifier that cannot access hidden tests or reference answers. It then runs verifier-guided beam search over a solution-construction graph. Within a fixed harness, a cheap model self-evolves skills that reach $74.9\%$ mean-of-3, $+14.8$ points over the $60.1\%$

translated_title: 基于代理引导的求解与复现的自我进化技能
translated_abstract: 智能体技能是智能体在部署时参考的指令和资源的可移植包。目前，让技能自我进化在两个方面存在失败。首先，从零开始进化的技能表现不如人工精选的技能，在弱模型上甚至不如完全不使用技能。其次，进化时的一次通过记录的是一条“幸运”的轨迹，而一个全新的随机智能体在部署时往往无法复现该轨迹。我们提出了reSolve，一个按任务进行、由oracle参与的框架，它建立在三个组件之上。它将交互式求解与一个自包含的交付物解耦，该交付物在全新的容器中独立重新执行，我们将这一协议称为“求解与复现”。它通过一个无法访问隐藏测试或参考答案的代理验证器来增强稀疏的奖励信号。然后在解构建图上运行验证器引导的束搜索。在固定的测试框架内，一个廉价模型自我进化的技能达到了74.9%的三次平均成绩，比60.1%的基线高出14.8个百分点。
tldr: 提出reSolve框架，通过“求解与复现”协议、无法访问隐藏测试的代理验证器以及验证器引导的束搜索，让廉价模型自我进化的智能体技能显著超越人工精选技能和完全不使用技能的基线。
en_tdlr: reSolve is an oracle-in-the-loop framework that self-evolves agent skills through a solve-and-reproduce protocol, a surrogate verifier without access to hidden tests, and verifier-guided beam search, enabling a cheap model's skills to reach 74.9% mean-of-3, +14.8 points over the 60.1% baseline.
